items.t: Capri Holdings Stock Has A New CEO Has The Bull Case Changed?
items.sum: Capri Holdings announced that long serving Chairman and CEO John D. Idol will retire, with Justin Boxford becoming CEO and joining the Board and Robin Freestone stepping in as Independent Chairman, all effective January 4, 2027. Idol will remain as a senior advisor through March 31, 2027. Boxford brings nearly three decades of global luxury and beauty experience across Estée Lauder, La Mer, TOM FO
